title: Demon Slayer Studio’s Major Upcoming Film Reveals Release Date With a New Trailer
content: Established in 2000, the renowned animation studio Ufotable is known for the hit Weekly Shonen Jump anime Demon Slayer . The series gave the studio a popularity boost like nothing else and helped it climb through the ranks to become one of the most successful studios in the industry.

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Main Cast
content: The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) television anime announced the main cast on Tuesday. The new TV anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates.

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals New Rudeus, Roxy and Sylphiette Greyrat Character Visuals Ahead of Upcoming Arc
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a new character visual for Rudeus Greyrat, as well as for Roxy and Sylphiette. The designs were revealed ahead of the next arc in the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ghost in the Shell by Science SARU Completely New Voice Cast Features Maaya Sakamoto as Motoko Kusanagi
content: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL has officially revealed its main voice cast following the broadcast of its first episode in Japan, confirming a complete recast. Among the biggest changes, Maaya Sakamoto has been cast as Motoko Kusanagi, succeeding the late Atsuko Tanaka, who passed away in August 2024 .
author: Anime Corner

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Trailer Unveils Anime’s Own Absolute Poison Ivy
content: Shangri-La Frontier isn’t quite an isekai, but that hasn’t stopped Sunraku’s story from becoming a major hit in the anime industry. Rather than seeing its star transported to a “real” magical world, the anime adaptation instead sees Rakuro Hizutome slapping on a virtual reality helmet to take part in an MMORPG.

title: 29 Years Later, One Piece Finally Starts Luffy’s Fight Against His Biggest Enemy
content: One Piece has reached the climax of the Elbaph Arc with the newest chapter of the series, and Luffy has finally kicked off his fight against the series’ biggest villain after 29 long years.

title: 9 Most Anticipated Upcoming Anime From Jujutsu Kaisen Studio
content: Established in 2011, animation studio MAPPA took only a few years to become one of the biggest in the industry. The studio is best known for creating famous shows such as Jujutsu Kaisen , Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan (from Season 4), and many more acclaimed series.
